balls.text: yorker, accurate, no room, can't get under it, and has hit this straight back to Bravo for a dot
Bravo is unlucky here. He fires in a yorker as Harbhajan is backing away. Hits the toe outside the line of the leg stump, but ricochet wrong-foots Dhoni and goes fine for four leg-byes to third man
lovely shot first ball, and you have to say this is poor bowling too. A length ball wide outside off, Harbhajan sits back, clears the front leg, and smashes this over extra cover for an excellent six
down the track to smash this length ball straight to long-off for one

wide of the crease again, a full toss to cramp him up, and it seems the plan for Pandya. He is cramped on the shot as he looks to go over midwicket. Raina charges in from the fence, and dives forward to take an excellent catch. Last four balls: two wickets and zero runs
Bravo goes wide on the crease, and fires in a yorker that goes between Pandya's legs for a dot

wide length ball, and he is lucky again as Rayudu misses out on the extra-cover drive. Tell you what, these last two balls were a big risk. A half-volley and a wide length ball, but they have taken a wicket without conceding a run
wide half-volley, Mohit gets away with it. Pollard hits this off the toe end as he looks to go over cover. The mis-hit settles with Raina at deep cover. A dot and a big wicket
Rayudu looks for that flick over short fine again, and Mohit goes full and wide. This time Rayudu has to open the face, and gets just the single to point
a length ball whizzes past the open face this time. No change of pace here

premeditation but this is almost de Villiers-esque. Rayudu has moved across to go over short fine leg, Mohit sees it and bowls a slower short ball, Rayudu is on his knee and completely out of position when he makes contact but he has sent it flying over short fine leg. He sees this fly for six even as he is laid flat on the ground
good yorker, on off, Pollard can't get under it. Gets just the single to long-on
full toss, angling in, driven to deep midwicket for one

another slower ball, Rayudu hasn't picked this, and gets a massive edge as he looks to drive over long-off. Smith comes under it for what looks like an easy catch, and then he drops it. Hard hands there
picks the slower ball a touch late, looks for the sweep, and it squeezes under his bat for a dot
too predictable. Rayudu is sitting back, waiting for a slower ball from Rayudu. Sure enough it arrives. And he has has punched this in the air, over cover for a six
full, really full, goes off the toe end of the bat for a single to long-off
slower ball, angling across him, cut away to deep cover for one

sliced away for a six. This is not fair, but this is modern limited-overs cricket. Nehra finally draws a mis-hit off a full ball outside off. Pollard is not close to the ball, which means it flies off the bace of the bat, but it has enough muscle behind it to just clear extra cover for the 23rd run off the over
this time the yorker goes wrong the other way. A low full toss outside off, and Pollard has hit a flat six over long-on

misses the yorker by inches. This is somewhere between a yorker and a half-volley. On middle and leg, and Pollard stays back to convert this into a proper half-volley and flocks this for a powerful four that scorches the outfield a bit as it goes
and good to see him go back to the yorker. Dug out back to him. Welcome back, Ashish

... but for this shot they needed a man deep in the stand behind midwicket. Nehra has surprisingly bowled a length ball. A nothing ball really. And Pollard has smoked this over midwicket for a massive six
on a length, outside off, opens the face to get a single
Rayudu makes room, short of a length, on off, and he steers this to third man for one
looks to give him the charge, is beaten by a length ball, and gets just a leg-bye
short of a length, excellently concealed slower ball. Pollard doesn't pick it, there is no room available, and he gets an inside edge onto the pad
short, rib high, pulled away wide of Ashwin at deep square for a couple
on a length, angling in, hit straight to midwicket. Mohit has made a good mini comeback after two ordinary overs
bouncer firs6 ball, and Pollard lets it go through to the keeper

bouncer from Smith, Rayudu is surprised by the legs on this, and the top edge falls between square leg and deep square leg. Bravo is the man going back to try to catch it over his shoulder, but loses it in the end and doesn't even make an effort. This isn't a chance, though, really
nice drive with an open face, wide of long-off, but Negi makes a flying save there to save two runs
premeditated but effective. Length ball outside off, and Rayudu moves across the line to slog-sweep this over midwicket. As if he were a spinner
short of a length, outside off, punched past cover for two
short of a length, holds its line, is a bit quick too. Beats the edge of Rayudu as he looks to open the face of the bat
wide length ball, Rayudu goes for the drive, plays down the wrong line, and is beaten
another poor delivery. Short and wide with the third man. All Pollard has to do is open the face and place it between point and short third man. Four he gets
bouncer, the ball doesn't come on. it is over head high, Pollard goes ahead with the hook. The ball flies down the ground, and luckily for Pollard it falls wide of long-on
short and wide, but a slower ball, which means the cut travels in front of square. Only one
short and wide, Bravo lucky that the cut has gone straight to deep cover
slower ball wide outside off, steered to third man for one
short of a length, angling in, defended back to Bravo
short of a length, outside off, pushed to deep cover for one
low full toss, driven wide of long-off for two
pushed back to Smith and he throws the ball back at Rayudu who has not even left the crease for a mili second
short of a length, into the ribs, bunted to fine leg for one
Raina saves four and then gives away one. Driven towards extra cover but Raina makes a spectacular diving save only to concede an overthrow as Pollard has hardly left his crease

and Super Kings have come back into the match.What a bowling change this has proved to be. A lovely yorker from Smith. Simmons gets a bit too cheeky with it. Looks to open the face to run this fine, the yorker squeezes past the bat, and kisses the outside of his off stump. This is the first time Smith has bowled this season. And it is in the big final with his team under the pump. And he has hit the off stump with a yorker

slower ball. Guess Rohit picked it but didn't time the shot well. Yes he picked the slower ball early. It was on a length, the slower offbreak, and Rohit set himself up for the big slog. In the end he got cramped a little, and ended up hitting this straight to long-on. So Bravo gets a wicket in the first over, but must it be the 12th or later?

wide length ball. Ordinary bowling really. On a length, not off pace, and Rohit drives this on the up for four all along the ground. That's Rohit's fifty. Fabulous innings in the big match after his team had lost a wicket in the first over
slower ball, into the pads, worked into the leg side for one
accurate length ball, cramps Simmons up, defended back to him
half-volley on middle and leg, elegantly driven to long-on for one
even Bravo makes a poor start. Short, wide, asking to be hit, and Rohit has cut this past point for four more. Plays this right under his eye. Lovely timing
Jadeja's poor form is hurting Super Kings here. This is fired in short and wide, and Simmons gets enough on the late cut to place this between point and short third man
fired in, but shortish, Rohit cuts, gets an edge. Ashwin does well to field this to his left at short third. Anything past him is a four
another full toss, wide this time, driven to deep cover for one
he is not even down on the ground to play a slog sweep, but he has managed to do so to a really full ball. There is a deep midwicket in place, and he gets just a single
on a length, outside off, gets a bottom edge on the cut
and Jadeja seems to have the yips. His last ball was a full toss to Simmons for four. This is too a full toss, on the pads, and is swept away by Simmons for four
driven on the up, with an open face, gets a single to deep cover

short of a length, into the pads, placed between the two men deep on the on side. Comes back for two. Rushing towards the orange cap. If he gets 90 here, he will be the leading scorer of the tournament
poor bowling again from Mohit. Short and wide, and cut away - as it deserves - for four

dropped. Only technically can you call this a drop. Simmons gets a thick leading edge and the ball lobs wide of backward point. Negi races towards it, flies towards for a desperate dive, but can only get his hands to it. As he makes impact with ground, the ball slips out. That brings up fifty for Simmons
driven on the up again, wide of cover this time, gets a single
driven on the up but straight to cover
short of a length again, Rohit content with a single to long-on after Simmons hit that six earlier in the over
short of a length, into the pads, punched to deep midwicket
lovely shot. As good as Rohit's drive last over. Charges down the wicket, reaches the pitch of the ball, and lofts him over long-on for another big one
flighted on off, pushed with an open face to cover-point
looks for the big drive, realises he is not quite to the pitch of the ball, and drives it to extra cover for one
flighted on off, pushed to long-on for one

bunted into the leg side, Rohit takes the deep square leg on, and takes a couple thanks to a wide throw. Dhoni doesn't emote too much on the field, but he can't stand ordinary fielding. He lets his fielder know it. Mohit Sharma is the fielder here

massive. Rohit is in dream touch tonight. Jumps out of the crease as Ashwin flights this. He is close to the pitch of the ball, but not too close. It gives him room to swing his arms, and he drives this over midwicket for a huge six
bowl the straighter one, pitches leg and goes with the angle. Rohit is looking for the spin, and has to defend it as he reads it off the pitch
worked into the on side for one
Simmons looks to make room, is beaten by an offbreak and is hit on the pad outside leg
fires one into the pads, and draws a dot
punched into the leg side for a single
fired into the pads, Dhoni is almost at leg slip moving with the angle of the ball, and still appeals for lbw. Perhaps making a statement after that Smith lbw?
short ball, wider ball, Simmons goers back to cut it. The ball deserves to go for four, and go for four it does
down the wicket to bunt this to deep midwicket for one
flighted on off, driven to long-off for another single
flighted outside off, driven to deep cover for one
juicy full toss to end the over, and Simmons sends it over mid-on to end a bumper Powerplay
Simmons takes him on again. As he charges down, Jadeja looks to go wide, but Simmons throws his arms at it, and sends this over mid-off. Gets a six off the bottom of the bat
totally round arm this time. His arm is as high as Malinga's. Defended back
fired in, defended again
a bit round arm from Jadeja, defended in front of the pad
Mumbai seems to have a strategy to not let Jadeja settle into a rhythm. Simmons slog-sweeps first ball, and clears midwicket easily
push-driven on the up, between mid-off and mid-on, gets a single

nicely played this time. This time he reacts to the ball as opposed to making the play first. This is short, rib high, there is no fine leg in place, and and he has played a clip-pull past the man in the circe for four
Simmons is premeditating a lot. He rocks back early and has made up his mind to pull this no matter the length. Eventually this is not short enough to be pulled and squeezes under his bat
Simmons gives Nehra the charge again, and Nehra slips in a yorker under his bat
steers a shortish delivery to third man for one
is it dropped? Not dropped but Dhoni won't be happy with this. Bouncer from Nehra as Simmons charges at him. It is not too high for Dhoni but he doesn't collect it cleanly and concedes a bye
slower offbreak, guided to short fine leg for one
short, and Ashwin gets away with it as Simmons has punched this straight to cover-point
fired into the pads, beats the inside edge again, and draws another dot
slower in the air, dips on him, creates the distance between the bat and the pitch of the ball, beats the inside edge, but is headed down leg
this is a low full toss, and Simmons has drilled this back over his head for a low flat six
sharp offbreak but he has overstepped. Rohit wants the leg-bye but Simmons sends him back. Almost as if both are eager to face the free hit
and he starts outside leg, opening up the sweep for Simmons with no fine leg in place. Ashwin won't be happy with it. Simmons takes the four runs gleefully
short one gets a bit big on Simmons, but the mis-timed pull falls short of long leg
short of a length, outside off, steers it to third man for one

beautiful. Rohit Sharma plays a lovely flowing cover-drive. This is pitched up outside off. Not quite the driving length, but he drives at it away from the body. Along the ground it goes, past the lazy Dwayne Smith at cover. Smith is taken out of that fielding position immediately
just short of a length, not the pulling length, but Rohit takes him on. Pulls this off the front foot, beats the outstretched hands of Pawan Negi at midwicket by inches
solid front-foot defence as Nehra gets the ball to swing back in a touch
Nehra continues to impress. Holds the line around off after pitching on a length. Simmons gets another inside edge for a single
this is poor bowling. Juicy short and wide delivery, at Eden Rohit can hit these for fours blindfolded. Through cover-point it goes
looks for the dab again but this short ball takes his inside edge through to fine leg. Could easily have chopped on
beats third man along the ground this time. Mohit stays short, Rohit leans back, and opens the face to guide this wide of slip and fine of third man

digs this one in short, gets it chest high, and despite the lack of pace on it, Rohit Sharma has upper-cut this over third man for a sis. Mumbai are off. He knows the short boundaries. He knows this ground. He loves it. he knows it like the back of his hand
short of a length, outside off, punched square on the off side, finds cover-point this time
short of a length, outside off, sits up a little, which means he hasn't timed the punch well, and finds the man at short cover anyway
a length ball angles across him, and he leaves alone. Superb over by Nehra

Faf du Plessis has produced the first bit of magic on the big night. Patel is out for a duck. He flicks this wristily towards mid-on. The ball is not hit well, which means they can think of a single. Du Plessis charges in, dives in to save time, is off balance, the ball hasn't sat properly in his right hand, but he flicks it underarm even as he comes down. The ball loops to the top of the stumps at the non-striker's end to catch the little Patel short
short of a length, punched crisply, but they have the square field on the off side packed. They know Patel loves that area
another half-volley, but it is swinging away from Patel, who pushes this back to Nehra
half-volley, Simmons looks to drive square on the off side, the ball swings back in to hit the thick inside edge of the bat
on a length, shapes back in towards off, defended to mid-off by Simmons
top edge over the keeper's head, but Mumbai Indians don't care where the ball has gone. This is a legal delivery, and that means they have won the IPL again
full length ball on off, he makes room and smashes this over extra cover for six
slows away at a full ball, gets a thick edge over point, and Suchith - not asked to bowl today - puts in an excellent save still. He could have taken it easy but hasn't
that's the flicker of the dying flame. Mohit backs away to smoke this short ball over extra cover for a big six
Mohit gives him the charge, yorks himself, gets a single to mid-off, and then an overthrow from Rohit. he laughs as he apologises to Vinay. He can afford to now
wide full toss, driven to deep cover
sharp bouncer, beats Mohit's pull to end McLenaghan's quota
dug in short, pulled away to deep midwicket for one
backs away to punch this shortish delivery to deep cover
high full toss, flicked to fine leg for one
another wicket goes down. A serious chance to bowl Super Kings out. Ashwin looks for a big hit, gets too under a length ball and is caught at wide long-on
full and wide, angling away, beats the outside edge as Ashwin looks to steer this square
slower ball, Ashwin makes room to work this for one
another slower ball to end the over, Ashwin opens the face for another single
slower ball again, on off, Ashwin opens the face for a single
slower ball again. Malinga doesn't need to exerts himself on yorkers now. This is short of a length, on the pads, gets Negi's leading edge, and lobs for an easy catch to point
another slower ball, Negi has no clue about it, and edges it to Patel on the bounce
slower ball but wide outside off and angles further away to go for an extra
full, middle and leg, worked away for a single
full toss on the pads, Jadeja short-arms this to deep midwicket for one
yorker, middle and leg, gets a single to long-on
full, middle and leg, driven to long-on for one
gets a freebie first up. A leg-stump half-volley that he glances away for four. Only about 19 of those required
du Plessis is down the wicket to drive at this wide and full ball, and can't clear extra cover. Another wicket falls. CSK could get bowled out here
wide length ball, it shapes away to beat du Plessis' drive
slower full ball, played with an open face, gets a single to point

slower-ball yorker. Gets under his bat, lands on the crease, hits the bat pad as he is on his knees trying to get under it. The ball ricochets off the pad, and hits the stumps. Malinga is called back to take a wicket, and he has taken out the big one
low full toss, he has placed it square of deep midwicket for two
no ball but not a free hit as he has hit the stumps with his front knee as he loads up to bowl. And that shortish ball beats Negi all ends up with pace
this is the yorker, and he just gets a single to long-on. Despite that six they are going slower than the asking rate this over
misses the yorker by inches. Dhoni goes back deep into the crease, takes this on the half-volley and lofts this over long-on. A semi helicopter
yorker outside off, dug out to deep cover for one
short of a length, on off, gets extra bounce, beats the edge as the asking rate crosses three a ball
this is proper short ball, and he has cleared the front leg to pull this to deep square for four
short of a length, and Dhoni fails to get the ball off the square again. The leading edge reaches mid-off on the bounce
short of a length, angling away, Bravo looks for a big hit, gets a thick edge and third man takes the catch
on a length, middle and leg, beats him with the angle here
length ball, on the pads, angling away towards off, Bravo lofts this down the ground. A mis-hit but straight of long-on
length-ball offbreak, worked to leg for a single. Harbhajan has hurt himself trying to collect this throw but he has bowled an excellent spell here
lovely bowling. Slow through the air, dipping on him, goes straight on, beats the outside edge
offbreak, on the pads, worked away fine

Harbhajan has another wicket. Raina won't get 400 for the season. Lovely stumping from Parthiv Patel. Harbhajan sees Raina coming, slips in a quick wide ball that lands just short of the popping crease, but Patel makes a superb collection and whips the bail off. Raina is down on ground, and so are Super Kings
tossed up outside off, driven but straight to cover-point
short of a length, offbreak, punched to deep cover for one
Rain finally gets four for his chip over cover. They have a deep cover placed for this shot, but this time Raina places it straight of the man
slower ball, Raina slogs, gets a thick inside edge for two to deep midwicket
dances down to drive this short-of-a-length ball for one
this time he pitches up and Dhoni gets bat on ball. Gets two runs with a punch in front of point
short of a length again, and beats Dhoni for pace again. Hits his thigh pad as he looks to work this to leg
short of a length, outside off, beats the punch of Dhoni
slow in the air, low full toss, driven to long-off for one. Dhoni and Harbhajan share a joke or something. Both are laughing

Illingworth has given Smith out lbw again. This time, though, he is plumb. This is a topsinner, pitched just outside off, doesn;t turn as much as an offbreak would, beats the sweep and hits him in front of middle. This is straightforward
only slightly short of a length, Smith rocks back to turn this into a proper short ball and pulls this between long-on an deep midwicket for a scorching four. The cheerleaders there nearly cleaned up
Raina charges down, turning this into a low full toss, and Harbhajan misfields in his follow-through to allow a single
short of a length, pulled towards deep midwicket for one
Rains looks for the chip over cover, but Rohit has blocked that shot with Pollard at deep extra cover. Single

lovely shot to bring up his fifty. Short of a length, just outside off, and somehow Smith makes some room. Meets this with an open face, placing it to the left of point and right of third man. Top shot
straight to short fine, this time they run through, and a wide throw from Malinga makes the single possible

Smith is caught ball-watching again. There is a big lbw shout here, but the ball has clearly pitched outside leg. Raina wants a leg-bye to short third man but Smith hasn't moved. raina is nearly run out but Harbhajan misses on the direct hit
this bouncer doesn't get as high as the earlier ones. This is only chest high and Raina pulls this through square leg for four
looks for the big drive to a length ball, gets a thick edge that falls short of third man
short ball, Smith plays the short-arm pull, places it between deep square and deep midwicket
Raina finally plays a convincing shot. Dances down the ground, is not close to the pitch of the ball but that only means he has room to swing his arms. Over long-on he goes for six
Harbhajan goes full, wide and fast, and Raina stands his ground. Called a wide
swept away for one

looks for the reverse-sweep, gets an edge that falls short of short third man. Smith has not only played an ordinary shot but is also caught sleeping. He sends Raina back even though this is Raina's call and he would have made the run easily. Smith caught ball-watching
flighted outside off, Smith looks for the slog sweep and is beaten comprehensively
full and straight, nearly a yorker, can't get under it. Takes a single to long-off. Bowled at 102ks
topspinner, Smith stays back to work this to leg for one
punched to deep cover for one

big shout. This is short of a length, outside off, and skids through and seams in to hit him dead in  front. Dharmasena doesn't give him. He thinks it is too high as this has hit Smith on the knee roll, but his leg is bent and he is deep in the crease. Awfully close, this. Hitting the top of middle for mine
short of a length, seams in a touch, beats the inside edge, hits the pad, draws another dot
looks to slip in the full wide ball, Smith has backed away a touch but somehow gets bat on it and manages to place it between mid-off and extra cover
short of a length, and beats Smith as he backs away
Pandya's response to that is a sharper bouncer. Right by SMith's nose it goes. Called no-ball because this is the second bouncer of the over. No free hit for this

Raina can't play the bouncer, Pandya knows it, and nearly gets him out. Raina has to hook, gets a top edge, and it somehow falls short of Simmons who is charging in from fine leg. Pandya is not happy with Simmons. He wanted more from the fielder
slogged away as this ball is pitched up, he has managed to place this straight of deep midwicket and gets a desperately needed boundary
chipped towards deep cover for one

Raina jumps out of the crease, is nowhere near the pitch of the ball, but it falls wide of long-on and speeds off after pitching on the a practice pitch. Gets two for it as rayudu makes an excellent save
short of a length, swerves in to beat the cut
slog-sweeps this one, but gets only a single to deep midwicket as the ball is too full for him to get under
reverse-sweeps the first ball as Harbhajan is a bit flat. Beats short third man, gets four
short of a length, into the pads, worked away for a single
short of a length, wide outside off, but it shoots through to beat the bottom edge
short of a length, outside off, moves in a little beats the inside edge as he looks to work this to leg
short of a length, beats Raina for pace, hits the pad, goes for a single off the inside edge
short again, this time it skids on and hurries Smith into the pull. The bottom edge goes for one
short-arm pull as Pandya bowls short into the ribs. That's Smith's favourite shot. Gets four past fine leg
short of a length, middle and leg, angles away and stays low to beat the outside edge
short of a length, outside off, pushed to long-on for one
another slog, and this one skids through to hit him on the pad
Smith is just swinging and hoping for the best. This short-of-a-length delivery stays a little low, moves back in a touch, and beats the slog
short of a length, punched straight to extra cover
Smith takes a risk, gets a big outside edge that flies over point. Two last balls, two edges, 8 runs. Is the break Super Kings are looking for?
and again. Raina hopping and skipping against quality fast bowling. Dug in short, he has no idea, throws his arms up in self defence, and gets an edge wide of slip
a sharp mean bouncer. Raina is not looking at the ball, throwing his hands up in defence like Mayweather against Pacquiao. But will Raina end with his hand raised?

wide full ball, Hussey sees some release, he drives it hard, goes uppishly to cover-point where Suchith seems to have taken a low catch but immediately says he is not sure. The soft signal as they go upstairs is not out. To me it looks like it bounced straight on the fingers. Mumbai have begun to celebrate as they look at the big screen. They are not even waiting for the official decision. That looks out to me. It looks like it has bounced, but it has bounced in his fingers that have kept the ball from touching the ground. Finally given out officially
short of a length, extra bounce, McLenaghan is giving this everything. Beats Hussey's cut with the bounce
on a length, pretty quick, no room, pushed to mid-off for one
heavy ball, on a length, middle and off. Hits the bat as opposed to the other way around. The leading edge goes to cover-point
finally gets bat on the cover-drive, drilling it over extra cover, inches away from the leap of Simmons there
and beaten on another cover drive. This time on the inside edge as the ball holds its line as opposed to going with the angle
and Hussey is struggling to lay bat on ball. Beaten third time in a row on the drive as a length ball angles across him
another length ball beats the drive, but this is somewhat harshly called a wide
length ball outside off, angling away, squeezes under the bat as Hussey looks to drive. Low bounce there
Smith's head falls away as he looks to pull, gets a single to long-on off the mis-hit
short of a length, on off, opens the face but doesn't get a single
that was a wide down the leg side - if the batsman had let it go. Smith wanted to help that past short fine leg for four, but he can only send it to the fielder there for a single
slower length ball from Malinga, on middle stump, patted back towards the bowler
length ball on the pads, thuds off the pad towards backward square leg
full toss outside off, Hussey looks to steer that through the covers, can't find the gap, plenty of dot balls already in this CSK innings
into the pads, short of length, clipped towards square leg for a single
back of a length ball on off stump, defended back towards the bowler
Hussey, facing his first ball, goes for a pull as he sees the ball a bit short, he misses
a short of length ball lashed back towards the bowler, McClenaghan gets his hand on that and the ball rolls towards mid-on
Smith was feeling the pressure there after some dots, he goes for his favourite swipe towards midwicket, a thick top edge over the keeper's head for six, lucky but that should settle him a bit
a touch short, a bit of width, slapped towards backward point, Pollard dives to his left to cut that off
back of a length ball on middle and leg, sliced towards point, can't get it past the fielder there
swing and a miss from Smith, pitching on a length and angling across past the outside edge beyond off
full and on the pads, Smith gets deep in the crease and taps the ball towards midwicket for a single to keep the strike, just five off the first over
slingy full ball from Malinga, punched back towards the bowler who takes the sting out of that shot with an outstretched right hand
length ball is slugged off the front foot past cover, this is a quick outfield at Eden Gardens and Smith has connected well, that's four
length ball on middle and leg, cramps up Smith who blocks it towards mid-on
length ball swerving away just outside off, there's a typical Dwayne Smith slog, meets thin air
Malinga starts with a ball that lasers in towards the batsman's toes, Smith gets his feet out of the way and defends that from within the crease, superb start from Malinga
